title: Small Gathering Planner
h1: A good gathering starts with one sentence about why, not a menu.
sub: Plan a dinner, a walk or a game night for six to ten people: a purpose sentence, a guest list, an invitation, and a follow-up.

stat.t: In-person time with friends fell from about 60 minutes a day in 2003 to about 20 in 2020. A small gathering with a purpose puts a few hours back on the calendar.
